title: Modification of Bekenstein-Hawking Entropy for the Non-Stationary Kerr Black Hole
content: According to the Lorentz-breaking theory, the dynamics equation for fermions is closely related to the form of gamma matrices. We select the proper form of gamma matrices γμ and γ5 corresponding to the non-stationary Kerr metric tensor gμν and obtain the modified fermion dynamics equation. Then using the WKB theory, we study the dynamic equation of spin-1/2 fermions in the non-stationary Kerr black hole. The quantum tunneling radiation characteristics of the non-stationary Kerr black hole are investigated. Finally, we obtain new expressions for the Hawking temperature and Bekenstein-Hawking entropy of the black hole and discuss their physical implications.
